steps.title: The orbit
steps.say: The Earth goes around the Sun once a year. Its axis is tilted 23.5° and always points the same way.

steps.title: Winter in the north
steps.say: Zoom in. Here the north pole leans away from the Sun, so sunlight hits the north at a low angle and the days are short: winter in the north, summer in the south.

steps.title: Half a year later
steps.say: Half a year later the Earth is on the other side. The axis still points the same way, so now the north pole leans toward the Sun: summer in the north.

steps.title: Between
steps.say: In between, the axis leans neither toward nor away from the Sun: spring or autumn, with the Sun overhead near the equator.

steps.title: Try it
steps.say: Your turn: drag the Earth around the orbit. The panel on the right is worked out by code from the position.
